messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager — prod-api-west 429 surge triggered (policy=ErrorBudgetPolicy). 429 rate > 6.5% over 5m. Pager routed to @Kate (oncall).

Kate (oncall): I’m on it. Jumping into dashboards now — pulling 5m/15m trends. Any known deploys?

Alex M: No deploys in last 30m from CI. I see a spike concentrated on /v1/completions and embeddings endpoints.

Maddie: Looks tenant-concentrated — top 3 tenants account for ~72% of 429 volume. Could be sudden client retry behavior or a cache warmup.

Kate (oncall): Good call. Can we do a quick containment: 1) soft-rate-limit offending tenants 2) disable experimental prefetch flag 3) enable per-route 429->429-backoff. I’ll also open a CS note for customers.

Dan: I can apply tenant shaping. Suggest starting at 20rps per tenant for the top noisy ones. Will run via rate-controller.

PlatformBot: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/7x9ij/edge-errors?orgId=1

Alex M: Query I’m watching (Prom):
```
sum(rate(http_responses_total{job="prod-api", code="429"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="prod-api"}[5m])) * 100
```

Kate (oncall): Dan — when you set the tenant rate, also add a 503 fallback rule so we don’t overwhelm the queue. Keep me posted on 5m windows.

Dan: Applying shape for tenants acme-inc, beta-app, fastspin:
```
rbctl tenant-rate set --tenant acme-inc --rate 20rps --env prod
rbctl tenant-rate set --tenant beta-app --rate 20rps --env prod
rbctl tenant-rate set --tenant fastspin --rate 15rps --env prod
```

Dan: Also toggling experimental cache prefetch flag off:
```
redwoodctl feature toggle --name exp-prefetch --state off --env prod --note "mitigating 429 surge"
```

Maddie: Noted. Kicking off a quick reroute policy to move best-effort traffic to cheaper model variants to reduce token pressure.

Kate (oncall): Watching metrics now. 429 pct went from 8.1% -> 3.4% within 3m after initial shapes. Good signal. Keep shaping for another 10m and monitor error budget.

Alex M: Also seeing an increase in p95 latency on the same routes — likely queuing. If latency keeps rising we should enable circuit-breaker (503 early) for the top path.

Kate (oncall): Agreed. If 429s don’t fall under 2% in next 10m, we enable circuit-breaker. For now continue shaping + flag off.

PlatformBot: Alert update posted to incident channel. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/429-mitigation

Dan: 10m check — 429 is 1.3% on prod-api-west (5m), overall p50/p95 stable. Tenant shaping reduced request rate from ~14k rps -> ~9.2k rps.

Kate (oncall): Nice work. Contacted growth to reach out to top affected customer engineers (acme-inc leads) to warn about the temporary throttle. CS already sent a bobble message.

Alex M: Quick note — we saw a correlated spike in backend datastore write latency around the time of the surge. Might be an upstream contributor. Will add ops ticket to follow up.

Maddie: Recommend follow-ups: postmortem, add tenant-level anomaly detector, tune backoff on SDK, and add a dashboard for per-tenant 429 trends.

Kate (oncall): Handoff: I’m going off-call in 15m. Leaving the mitigation in place (tenant shapes + flag off). Dan — you’re primary. Keep watching 5m/15m 429 percents and latency. Escalate to infra if 5m 429 > 2.5% persists for 10m.

Dan: Ack. Will hold until clearance. Setting a temporary watch:
```
alertctl create --name "prod-429-watch" --expr 'sum(rate(http_responses_total{code="429",job="prod-api"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="prod-api"}[5m])) > 0.025' --for 10m --team eng-sre
```

Kate (oncall): Thanks all. Quick incident note for postmortem: root-cause unknown (possible datastore pressure + client retry pattern). Actions taken: tenant shaping, feature flag off, model-reroute. Impact: transient 429 spike affecting a handful of tenants, CS notified.

PlatformBot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1423. Summary and timeline auto-populated.

Dan: Monitoring continues. 429 steady at ~0.9% last 5m, p95 latency improving. I’ll keep the shaping for 45m more and then begin gradual relax if stable.

Kate (oncall): Good. Post-incident tasks assigned: Alex M -> datastore follow-up, Maddie -> dashboard & anomaly detector, Dan -> rollback plan for shapes. I’ll draft the postmortem once I’m back on call. :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: :white_check_mark: Pager resolved (auto) — mitigation in place, monitor until ticket closed.
